A box of mass 4.0kg is pulled along a horizontal floor in a straight line by a constant force F.
The constant frictional force acting on the box is 2.0N.
The speed of the box increases from 0.50m/s to 2.5m/s in 2.0s.
What is the value of F?

2.0N
B
4.0N
C
6.0N
D
7.0N
